description: This file defines a Flutter widget called PaymentMethodSheet, which provides a bottom sheet UI for selecting payment methods such as Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, or Cash. It includes methods for launching external payment apps via deep links and handles fallback scenarios when apps are not installed.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a bottom sheet for selecting among multiple payment options including Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash, with deep link support.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the payment method sheet, including payment options and visual layout.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Helper method that constructs a list tile for each payment method option, with icon, color, and tap handling.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch the specified payment app via its URI scheme; shows a snackbar if the app is not installed.
